avatar_hover.title: Hover Height
avatar_hover.description: Nudges your avatar up or down -- fixes a mesh body/shoe that doesn't quite touch the ground.

environment.title: Environment — Windlight
environment.use_region_tooltip: Drops the selected presets and goes back to the environment the sim sends.

snapshot.title: Snapshot
snapshot.capture_failed: Capture failed: the viewport returned no image.
snapshot.captured: Captured {0} × {1}. Save it, or capture again.
snapshot.folder_tooltip: Where snapshots are saved. Use "Choose folder…" to change it.
snapshot.hide_hud_tooltip: Hides every window, toolbar and overlay so you can compose the shot with a clean view. This window hides too — bring it back from View → Toggle HUD in the top menu.
snapshot.dof_enable_tooltip: Blurs everything outside the sharp band. Off by default — it costs a full-screen blur pass, and auto focus costs a raycast.
snapshot.dof_auto_focus_tooltip: Follows whatever is in the centre of the view. Turn it off to set the focal distance by hand.
snapshot.dof_focus_tooltip: Distance to the plane that stays sharp. Dragging this switches auto focus off.
snapshot.dof_range_tooltip: How many metres stay sharp, centred on the focal plane. Smaller is a shallower, more cinematic focus.
snapshot.dof_falloff_tooltip: How gradually the blur builds up with distance. Low is a hard cut at the sharp band; high keeps the blur climbing all the way into the distance, the way a real aperture does.
snapshot.dof_near_blur_tooltip: Blur what is nearer than the sharp band too, not just what is behind it.
snapshot.dof_no_target: nothing in the centre of frame

preferences.title: PREFERENCES
preferences.toolbar_heading: Buttons shown on the bottom bar:
preferences.ui_scale_hint: Resizes floating windows and the HUD live. Applies to newly opened windows too.
preferences.camera_speed_hint: Multiplies the speed of the on-screen Camera Controls pads. 100% is the default.
preferences.camera_view_hint: FOV and focus height apply live; the rear view distance takes effect on the next camera reset (Esc).
preferences.vsync_hint: With V-Sync on, a frame that just misses the refresh deadline waits for the next one, so a client short of 60 FPS reads as a steady 30. Turn it off to see the real frame rate.
preferences.licenses_missing: The third-party notice file is missing from this build. This is a licensing problem, not a display one — please report it.
preferences.maturity_blurb: Choose what maturity rating of regions and content Second Life shows you. This has no effect on OpenSim.
preferences.maturity_unsupported: This grid does not support a content-rating preference (OpenSim has no equivalent of Second Life's General/Moderate/Adult system).
